breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes ω = 2π(rpm/60) = 2π(1800/60) rad/s, properly converting rpm to radians per second before using it in P = Tω. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction to substitute rpm directly as ω.
